title: Co-transcriptional quantification of RNA synthesis, RNA folding and RNA-protein interactions by "Systems NMR" approach.
protocol: Clone the template DNA under T7 RNA Pol promoter.
Purify DNA template using Nucleobond Xtra Maxi or an equivalent kit from Qiagen.
Yield per column ≥250-350 μg pTX1 plasmid DNA template, enough for ~10 transcription-NMR reactions (450 μl each, at 33 nM DNA template).
Vortex the DNA pellet.
Incubate for 10-20 minutes at 50°C.
Vortex again.
Freeze at -20°C.
Thaw the sample.
Use pipette to detach the pellet if necessary after the first vortex cycle.
Repeat cycles of vortexing, incubating, freezing, thawing for a total of three cycles.
Linearize the pTX1 plasmid using BsaI enzyme at 1.5U/ug DNA in NEB buffer 3.1 for 13-15 hours at 50°C.
Inactivate the reaction for 1 hour at 65°C.
Check plasmid cleavage on a 1% agarose gel.
Run small-scale transcriptions (~25 μl) using denaturing PAGE with urea to optimize MgCl2 concentration for transcription.
Transfer protein into Tris-Triton-DTT (TTD) buffer: 40 mM Tris-HCl, 0.01% Triton-X100, 5 mM Dithiothreitol, pH 7.7.
Monitor the pH change from the shift of 31P xPO4 signal.
Monitor the pH change from the shift of 1H Tris signal.
Pre-lyophilize NTPs, MgCl2, and DNA template components together if a larger sample volume is needed for protein or additive addition.
Add T7 RNA polymerase only after recording time0 reference spectra.
Create new dataset including main information in its name.
Make temperature calibration.
Insert the sample into magnet.
Wait 1 min for temperature equilibration.
Run `nmr/py/in_v02.yn.py` script for setup of series.
Check and test the script carefully before doing real runs.
Set SW / carrier / TD parameters in 2DHN spectrum to optimal values.
Run `paropt` procedure and store results in expno 4 999.
Enter 90-degree 31P pulse value from paropt into 1D31P experiment.
Check tune-match of channels of interest if drift is expected.
Start reference (time0) experiments.
Turn off Autoshim to avoid variation in lineshapes between spectra.
Use `nmr/py/createExpSeries.py` to generate time-series of repeating experiments based on reference spectra.
Take sample out of the magnet.
Add T7 RNA Pol, mix the sample, spin if needed to remove bubbles, insert sample back into the magnet.
Lock, perform temperature equilibration, check tune-match.
Perform topshim twice.
Note and record the time at which the RNA Pol was added.
Start experiment series (`qumulti ##-##`).
Sort data by experiment type using the script.
Add rough experiment time to the title of each dataset.
Create a cara repository with linked 2DHN spectra and `integr_datasets_31P.txt` file for 31P integration.
Use helper scripts `res.py`, `md.py`, `zim.py`, and `zh33.py` in TopSpin for quick visualization or comparison of data.
Manually determine the phases of 1D1H, 1D1H-iminos, and 2DHN spectra for optimal results.
Check the common phase for time-resolved series on the second spectrum after T7 addition for 1D1H and 2DHN spectra.
Process 1D31P data using `qumulti 5000-5500`.
Execute processing command in TopSpin: `SR -139; si 64k; wdw EM; lb 2; efp; apks; absf1 14; absf2 -26; absg 5; absn`.
Integrate data using the TopSpin `intser` command, pointing to the `integr_datasets_31P`.
Create a project and a peaklist in a Cara repository.
Pick peaks of interest in the 2DHN spectra.
Trace the positions of picked peaks across time series using peak aliasing in Cara Monoscope.
Move between spectra using `Ctrl+1` and `Ctrl+2`.
Move a peak or its alias using `mp / ma`.
Go to a specific peak using `gp`.
Switch to the first spectrum in the series using `gs`.
Read 31P integrals from the 31P integration file.
Retrieve 2DHN chemical shifts from the Cara repository.
Create a data structure for ODE model fitting in the `ODE/v01/model_and_data/data_for_fit` folder.
Generate an "ivtnmr" data object in the `ODE/v01/model_and_data/data_ivtnmr_full/` folder, which contains main information about the IVTNMR experiment.
Duplicate and rename the code in the `v01` folder for version tracking when making adjustments to data analysis or model structure.
Run `analysis/ODE/v01/a_fit_multi.m` to fit multiple IVTNMR datasets sequentially.
Read the ODE model from the `model_and_data/xIVT.mdf` file.
Fit the ODE model into experimental data from the `model_and_data/data_for_fit` folder generated at the previous step.
Adjust the RNA length in the MDF file to match the specific RNA length being studied.
Run `analysis/ODE/v01/a_visualize.m` to visualize ODE fit results.
Read fitting results from `ODE/v01/model_and_data/a_fit_multi.mat`.
Visualize fitted constants, replicates, and errors.
Run `analysis/LW/a_fit_LW.m` to fit and visualize imino linewidths.
Assume a single peak with Lorentzian lineshape for the fitting.
Decrease of pH during reaction might lead to slight systematic change of linewidth with reaction time.
Consider potential baseline correction if appropriate.
Factor out apparent narrowing of linewidth caused by growing baseline in crowded regions, assuming fixed zero intensity baseline.
Note that intrinsic broadening of one imino signal cannot be distinguished from broadening due to overlap with neighboring signals.
Edit the BioNetGen network definition (`ODE/v01/model_and_data/xIVT.bngl`) in RuleBender software or text editor.
Recompile the model.
Change directory to `ODE/v01/model_and_data`.
Run the compilation command: `../../../soft/BioNetGen217/Perl2/BNG2.pl xIVT.bngl`.
Convert the model to MDF format using the `convertBNGL_to_MDF` function.
Adjust the fitting routine `v01/a_fit.m` to match observables/data/constants used in the new network model.
Check the order/number of data vectors used for fitting (needs to match the observables in mdf file) - check `obs_data_to_keep` variable.
If added new observables/reactions: Check if model initial parameters are set correctly.
If added new constants/parameters: Check their initial values in the `a_fit.m` file and/or exclude from optimization.
Potentially add normalization and saving of new constants/parameters into the output of model fit results.
